content.short: Alty focuses on making chat more functional and crypto more social.
content.description: Alty targets three core challenges for growing communities: attracting and activating new users, enabling immediate actions when users are on the go, and simplifying crypto concepts for beginners. It provides interactive chatbots that users can engage with directly, or that can be added to a chat group to reach people where they already chat. Use Alty by talking with its chatbots or by adding it to your chat group to boost onboarding speed and reduce early friction for newcomers.
